content:
I notice that we have both tendsto_atTop_iSup and tendsto_atTop_ciSup. I think this is a bit repetitive and I believe if we use tacticBddDefault, then we can deprecate tendsto_atTop_iSup.

There are several similar examples right now in the existing library. I wonder whether it makes sense maybe to use an AI to find all similar examples and then use bddDefault tactic. Does this sound like a reasonable change we want?
